explication: DBX is a multi-database client and management platform, offered as desktop, Docker/web, CLI, AI assistant, and MCP server. Its principal workflow is a user composing and executing database work, with DBX routing it through shared query and driver layers to a connected database and presenting results. The repository also documents schema, backup, administration, and plugin capabilities. Edges use the README or shown source-index references; several subsystem links are necessarily broad because their implementation was not sampled.
